messages:
maria: Heads up — saw a perf/quality regression in canary for mixtral-8k when we flipped kernel-selection=v2 + adaptive-batcher=yarn. Sequence 16k workloads show perplexity spike and latency variance. Logs pasted below. :eyes:

chris: can you paste the bench command & profiler diff?

maria: Ran: `rdwctl bench --model mixtral-8k --seq 16384 --qps 10 --kselection v2 --batcher adaptive=yarn` Results: p50 latency 220ms -> 340ms, p95 480ms -> 1.1s, eval perplexity on seq-ref set: 12.3 -> 23.7. KV hit-rate dropped 0.74 -> 0.47. Attached profiler sample.

sylvie: repo kernel change? v2 selects fused-attn path + head-slice optimization. That should reduce runtime not increase it. Could be interaction with KV eviction and batching thresholds causing cache trash.

maria: profiler snippet:

```
cpu: scheduler wait increased 2.8x
gpu: launch latency + kernel serialization on head-slice
kv_cache: evict rate 14.2/s -> 48.9/s
batching: mean batch size 6 -> 14 (more variance)
```

perf-bot: Automated profile diff: increased memcpy+serialize time by 60%, kernel occupancy down 8%.

chris: hypothesis: kernel-v2 assumes stable KV layout (aligned kv-slot stride) — yarn adaptive batcher changes request ordering so more unique prefixes leading to cache thrash. Also head-slice fused kernels might be less tolerant to partial-kv misses, causing recompute.

sylvie: quick repro plan: 1) run bench with fixed-orderer (no yarn) to confirm. 2) try kernel-v2 + yarn but disable head-slice slice-fuse flag. 3) collect KV slot histograms.

maria: I'll run 1 & 2 on canary pool tonight. If it reproduces we'll revert kernel-v2 on canary, roll back to kernel-v1 for mixtral-8k. Also need to notify dedicated infra.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: kernel-selection=v2 -> 30% on mixtral-8k at 2024-10-11T02:14:00Z. Revert command: `rdwctl deploy rollback --model mixtral-8k --tag kernel-v1`

chris: small note — embedding models (qwen-14b) not affected, seems specific to kv-dense shapes.

sylvie: if hypothesis holds we should add a kernel compatibility gate: disable head-slice-fuse when adaptive-batcher=yarn or when seq>8k.

maria: thanks. I'll post results here. TL;DR: kernel-v2 + yarn -> KV eviction spike -> latency & perplexity regression on longctx mixtral; triage in progress. :bug:
